facts.text: Concordia Nebraska guarantees at least $27,500 per year in financial aid to undergraduates studying for church work vocations like pastors and teachers.

sources.title: Updated Lutheran Guarantee program promises even more aid to ...
sources.quote: A minimum of $27,500 per year is guaranteed to undergraduate students pursuing a degree in church work, which includes future teachers, directors of Christian education, musicians, pastors and others.
